title: Boundaries of integer lattice chains are integer multiplicity
statement: Let P, m ∈ ℕ, ρ > 0, β : LatticeFaceIndex (m+1) P → ℤ, and Pc ∈ D_{m+1}(ℝ^P) with Pc(ω) = Σ'_F β(F)·latticeFaceAction ρ F ω for every ω ∈ D^{m+1}(ℝ^P) (IsLatticeChain ρ β Pc). Then ∂Pc ∈ D_m(ℝ^P) is an integer multiplicity current.
lean_statement: ∀ (P m : ℕ) (ρ : ℝ), 0 < ρ → ∀ (β : LatticeFaceIndex (m + 1) P → ℤ) (Pc : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Eucl P)) (m + 1)), IsLatticeChain ρ (fun F => (β F : ℝ)) Pc → IsIntegerMultiplicity Pc.boundary
